- Guarding without being raided scores 0 POINTS.
- A player may be a raider and a raid target in the same round. Add all applicable POINTS.

Public pledges allow players to warn targets, coordinate pressure, or misdirect opponents. Only the act choices determine scoring. Scores accumulate across all 7 rounds; highest total wins, with ties shared.
